DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a walking path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、子どもは遊具で遊んでいます。周りを歩きながら見ていたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子を遊具で遊ばせ周囲を歩きながら見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child is on the playground equipment, and I would like to watch while walking around nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to watch your child on the play equipment while walking around. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 歩く場所によって遊具が見えない区間があります。ほかに見守る方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some sections of the path have no view of the equipment. Is anyone else supervising?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は私だけです。近い道ならずっと見えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 単独見守りで近ければ視界が続くと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only me today. I thought I could keep seeing my child as long as the path was close.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are supervising alone and thought a nearby path would keep your child in view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見守りと散歩を同時にできるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may not be able to supervise and take a walk at the same time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。今は散歩をやめ、遊具を見られる場所で見守ります。ベンチはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 散歩を止め見守り場所のベンチを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will skip the walk for now and supervise from somewhere with a view of the equipment. Is there a bench?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop the walk and ask about a bench from which to supervise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる場所を確認します。ベンチからも視界を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check which places are available. Please check the view from the bench too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、座れるだけで見守れるとは思わず、子どもが見える位置を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座席があっても子の視界を確かめて選ぶと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will choose a place where I can see my child, rather than assume any seat is suitable for supervision.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your view of the child even when a seat is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お子さんと一緒に歩く場合の道も案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I can also show you a path to walk with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 遊びが終わったら一緒に短く歩きます。そのときに入口へ戻る道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遊び後に子と短く歩く帰路の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will take a short walk together after playing. Please show us a route back to the entrance for then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a short route back to walk with your child after playing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今の見守る場所と、お二人で戻る経路を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will show you separately a place to supervise now and a return route for both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅への経路をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I show you the way to the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この小さい入口が近いので、そちらへ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近い小入口への道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This small entrance is close, so I would like to go there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the way to the nearby small entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その入口が今利用できるか確認しましょう。地図以外の案内は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check whether it is open now. Have you seen any information besides the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見ていません。地図にあればいつでも開いていると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図上の入口を常時利用可と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I thought that if it was on the map, it would always be open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought an entrance shown on the map was always accessible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の利用状況を確認します。荷物が多いのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check its current availability. You have a lot of luggage, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、入口で引き返すとつらいので、開いている経路を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重い荷物で戻らず使える入口を先に知りたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Turning back from the entrance would be hard, so I want to know which route is open first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that with heavy luggage you want to know the usable entrance before going, to avoid turning back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の入口は少し遠いですが、設備も含めて確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The other entrance is a little farther away, but I can check its facilities too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。近さだけでなく、スーツケースで通れる道かも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 距離とケースを運べる設備経路の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Besides the distance, please tell me whether I can take my suitcase along the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the distance and facilities along a route usable with a suitcase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。今使えるのは正面入口です。スーツケースを持って改札へ進める道はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked. The main entrance is open now. This route takes you to the gates with your suitcase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。正面入口へ向かうことを迎えの家族へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認された正面入口へ向かうことを迎えの家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will tell my family coming to meet me that I am heading for the main entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your family meeting you that you are heading for the confirmed main entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この道から正面入口へお進みください。小さい入口へ行って引き返す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow this path to the main entrance. You do not need to go to the small entrance and turn back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前の住所の書類を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please show me your documents for your previous address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。以前引っ越したときの書類を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前の転居書類を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here they are. I brought the documents from a previous move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the documents from an earlier move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の直前の住所についての書類ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are they for the address you lived at immediately before this move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、二年前のものです。その後もう一度引っ越しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二年前の書類で直前住所ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, they are from two years ago. I moved once more after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the documents are two years old and not for your immediately previous address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の移動の情報と分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check them separately from the information about this move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、古い書類を今回の証明として使わず、直前の住所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古資料を現証明にせず今回の前住所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not use these old documents as proof for the current move; I will give my immediately previous address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will provide the latest previous address, not use old documents as current proof. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 直前の住所に関する手続きはされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you completed the procedures for that immediately previous address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: しましたが、控えは自宅です。持っていないことと、手続きをしていないことを分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 直前手続は済み控え未持参と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, but the copy is at home. I will distinguish not having it with me from not having completed the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clarify that the procedure was completed but you did not bring the copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な資料を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the documents needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日全部済むと決めず、不足している資料と次に来るときの持参物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足資料と次回持参物の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not assume everything can be done today. Please tell me what is missing and what to bring next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the missing documents and what to bring on the next visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回の住所と手続き状況を確認し、必要なものをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the addresses for this move and the procedural status, then explain what is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 変更したい予約はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which appointment would you like to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族がこの画面を送ってくれました。火曜日の予約を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族送信画面の火曜予約の変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family sent me this screen. I would like to change the Tuesday appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to change the Tuesday appointment on the screen your family sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示された患者のお名前はご本人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the patient name shown your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母の名前でした。私の予定を送ってくれたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 患者名は母で本人予約と誤解したと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is my mother’s name. I thought they had sent my schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the patient name is your mother’s and you mistook it for your own appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お母様の予約とご自身の予約を分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish your mother’s appointment from your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、母の予約は変えません。私の予約の控えを確認してからお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母予約を変更せず本人控えを確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not change hers. I would like to check my own appointment confirmation before asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave your mother’s appointment unchanged and check your own confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の診察券や予約の情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have your own patient card or appointment details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察券があります。私の予約日時がわかるか、本人確認して調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人診察券で予約日時の照会を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my patient card. Could you verify my identity and check whether you can find my appointment date and time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check your appointment date and time using your own patient card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。変更を希望する理由も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Please also tell me why you want to change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕事の予定と重なります。正しい日時がわかったら、重なる時間帯と代替候補を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい日時確認後に仕事重複と代替候補を伝えると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It overlaps with work. Once I know the correct appointment time, I will explain the overlap and possible alternatives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after confirming the correct time you will explain the work conflict and alternative times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずご本人の予約を特定してから、変更の相談を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let us identify your own appointment first, then discuss changing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車はどこから見当たらなくなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where was your bicycle when it went missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の駐輪場所です。ただ、先週家族が修理店へ持って行ったことも思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅にないが家族の修理持込を思い出したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At our home’s bicycle parking area. But I also remembered that my family took it to a repair shop last week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that it is missing from home but you remembered your family taking it for repair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 修理店から戻ったことは確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed that it came back from the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。家にあるはずと決めて探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店からの返却は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I was looking for it assuming it must be at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that its return from the shop has not been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家族や修理店へ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check with your family or the repair shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族へ聞きます。引き取りを頼まれたかどうかも、私の記憶が曖昧です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へ引取依頼の有無も聞くと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my family. I am not even sure whether they asked me to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will also ask your family whether you were asked to collect it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 修理の控えがあれば確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the repair receipt if you have one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に控えがあります。自転車の番号と預けた日を見て、店へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修理控えの番号と日付で店舗確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is at home. I will check the bicycle number and drop-off date and contact the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check with the shop using the number and date on the repair receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今の段階で盗まれたと決めず、確認状況をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us what you have confirmed without deciding at this stage that it was stolen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。店で保管中なのか、引き取り後なのかを確認し、その結果で相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保管中と引取後を調べ結果をもとに相談継続すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will find out whether it is still at the shop or has been collected, then continue the consultation based on that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check whether it is stored or already collected and continue based on the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身で見たことと修理の手続きの情報を整理してお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please organize what you personally saw and the repair-procedure information and let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの封筒で送られますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この小さい封筒です。書類を半分に折れば入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小封筒に半折りで入れる予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This small one. The documents will fit if I fold them in half.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to fold the documents in half to fit the small envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先から折り方や梱包の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the recipient specify any folding or packaging requirements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 折らずに提出とあります。封筒代を先に考えて、条件を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折らず提出指定を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to submit them unfolded. I thought about the envelope cost first and missed that requirement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you overlooked the requirement to submit the documents unfolded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 折らずに入る大きさを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check a size that holds them without folding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。書類はまだ折っていません。大きい封筒と折れを防ぐ方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未折で大封筒と折れ防止方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have not folded them yet. I would like advice on a larger envelope and preventing creases.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that they are not folded and ask about a large envelope and protection against bending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 梱包に応じた大きさと料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the size and postage for the packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、小さい封筒の料金のまま送れるとは考えず、準備後の大きさで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 梱包後サイズで送料確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not assume the small-envelope rate applies; I will check using the size after packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check postage based on the packaged size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先も提出案内と照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare the address with the submission instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。条件に合う梱包をして、宛先と料金を確認してから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件に合う梱包と宛先料金確認後に送ると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will package them according to the requirements and check the address and postage before sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will send them after suitable packaging and checking the address and postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類を傷めない梱包の相談と、配送条件の確認を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let us discuss packaging that protects the documents and check the delivery conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご本人の口座開設をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to open an account for yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、家族の分も一緒に作りたいです。家族は今日は来ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人と不在家族の二口座を作りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, and I would also like to open one for a family member. They are not here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want two accounts, one for yourself and one for an absent family member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の申し込みと、家族の方の相談は分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your application separately from the inquiry about your family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。家族の情報を書けば、私が代わりに開設できるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 情報記入だけで代理開設できるとはしないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I will not assume that entering their details allows me to open one on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that filling in their information does not by itself mean you can open an account for them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家族の方は口座開設を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does your family member want to open an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、希望は聞いています。ただ、本人の確認方法や来店が必要かは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族希望は確認済みで本人確認条件は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, they have told me they do. But I do not know how identity verification works or whether they need to visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that their wish is confirmed but you do not know the identity-verification requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が手続きの条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は私の申し込みを相談し、家族には本人向けの案内を持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人申込と家族用案内持帰りを分けて頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I would like to discuss my own application and take home instructions addressed to my family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask separately about your application and taking instructions home for your family member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 家族の方の資料をお持ちでも、提出が必要か確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if you have their documents, please check whether they need to be submitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。必要のない家族の書類を渡さず、本人が何を準備するか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族資料を不必要に渡さず本人準備物を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not hand over family documents unnecessarily; I will ask what they need to prepare themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask what the family member must prepare without unnecessarily handing over their documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の手続きと、不在の家族の方への案内をそれぞれ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will explain your own procedure and the information for your absent family member separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの飲み物の値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the price of this drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、棚に八十円とあります。六本の箱も八十円ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六本箱も一本値札価格か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The shelf says 80 yen. Is a box of six also 80 yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the six-bottle box costs the same as the single-bottle price tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その値札は一本の表示です。箱の表示も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That tag is for one bottle. Let us check the box price too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一本と箱を同じ商品単位だと思っていました。箱の価格を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一本と箱を混同したと説明し箱価格を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought one bottle and a box were the same unit of sale. Please tell me the box price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused one bottle with a box and ask the box price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの箱の値札を確認します。必要なのは六本ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the box’s price tag. Do you need six bottles?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は二本だけです。箱が目立っていたので取りましたが、必要数で選び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要数は二本で箱選択を見直したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only two today. I picked up the box because it stood out, but I want to choose again based on what I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you need two and want to reconsider choosing the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一本ずつ販売している商品もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are drinks sold individually too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では二本を候補にします。箱を自分で開けて二本だけ取ってよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を勝手に開けずばら売りを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will consider two individual bottles. I will not assume I can open the box myself and take just two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for individually sold bottles without opening the box without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ばら売りの商品はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。箱の物を正しい場所へ戻し、ばら売り二本の合計を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を戻し二本の合計支払額を確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will put the box back in the right place and check the total for two individual bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return the box and check the total payment for two bottles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: このばら売りは一本税込み八十円です。二本で百六十円として、こちらの商品を会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: These individual bottles are 80 yen each including tax. Two are 160 yen; please take these to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の途中で休む場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest during your walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、飲み物も補充したいです。あの給水の表示の所で、ボトルに水を入れてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩と飲料補充を希望し給水表示の設備利用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, and I need more drinking water. May I fill my bottle at that water-supply sign?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want a rest and more drinking water, and ask about the facility marked as a water supply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この教材の設備は植え込みに水をまくためのものです。飲用の案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this exercise, that facility supplies water for the plants. It is not marked as drinking water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 給水とあれば飲む水だと思っていました。ボトルにはまだ入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 給水を飲用と思ったがボトル未充填だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought a water-supply sign meant drinking water. I have not filled my bottle yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed it was drinking water but have not filled your bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用途がわからない設備を開けず、飲用の場所の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not turn on equipment if you do not know its purpose. Please check where drinking water is provided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、少し味見して判断することもせず、飲用として案内される場所があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未確認設備を使わず味見せず飲用場所の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not even taste a little to judge it; I would like to ask whether there is a designated drinking-water point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not use or taste water from unconfirmed equipment; ask for a drinking-water location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる場所を担当に確認します。今、手元に飲み物は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the person in charge where you can use drinking water. Do you have any drink left?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少しあります。補充場所がわかるまで散歩を延ばさず、近くで休みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残飲料が少なく補充未確認の間は延長せず休みたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: A little. Until I know where to refill, I would rather rest nearby than extend my walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that little drink remains and you want to rest rather than extend the walk before finding a refill point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の近くのベンチへ戻る道を案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I can show you the way back to a bench near the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今ある飲み物を持ってそこへ戻り、補充の案内が確認できてから続けるか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口ベンチへ戻り補充案内確認後に続行判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will take my remaining drink there and decide whether to continue once the refill information is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return to the entrance bench and decide about continuing after confirming refill information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。散水用の設備は使わず、こちらの道で入口近くのベンチへお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Do not use the watering equipment; please follow this path back to the bench near the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換え先の方向を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the direction for your transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、右の矢印に従ったのに、同じ場所へ戻りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右矢印に従い同所へ戻ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I followed the arrow pointing right, but ended up back in the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that following the right arrow brought you back to the same place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの案内を、どちら側から見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which sign did you look at, and from which direction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で振り返って看板を見ました。前を向いた時も同じ右だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 振り返って読んだ向きを進行時に混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I turned around to look at the sign along the way. I thought it meant the same right after I faced forward again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused the direction seen while looking back with the direction when moving forward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 看板を正面から見た方向と、今の向きを合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us match the direction shown when facing the sign with the way you are facing now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。戻ったからとまた同じ右へ曲がらず、現在地から確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ曲がり方を反復せず現在地から確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Instead of turning right in the same way again because I came back, I want to check from my current location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check from your current location instead of repeating the same turn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内板では目的の乗り場は左の通路です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this sign, the passage on the left leads to your platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左の通路ですね。途中の分岐でも乗り場名を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内された左通路と途中分岐確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The passage on the left, understood. I will check the platform name at junctions along the way too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the indicated left passage and checking junctions along the route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 向きがわからなくなったら、近くの係員へ聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you lose your bearings, please ask a nearby staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、矢印だけ記憶せず、乗り場名と通路の目印を一緒に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 矢印記憶だけでなく乗場名と目印を使うと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will look at the platform name and passage landmarks together, rather than just remember the arrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use platform names and landmarks, not just remember the arrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在地を基準に案内を見て、左の通路へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Use your present location as the reference when reading the signs, and take the left passage.
